description: Weekly United States Hospitalization Metrics by Jurisdiction, During Mandatory Reporting Period from August 1, 2020 to April 30, 2024, and for Data Reported Voluntarily Beginning May 1, 2024, National Healthcare Safety Network (NHSN) - ARCHIVED is published by CDC Division of Healthcare Quality Promotion (DHQP) Surveillance Branch, National Healthcare Safety Network (NHSN). The archive reports hospital admissions and occupancy measures by jurisdiction through successive NHSN reporting regimes. Its stated coverage is United States; jurisdiction-level weekly reports beginning August 2020. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is Public Domain U.S. Government. The provider stopped updates after 1 November 2024 and warns of changes between mandatory and voluntary reporting. For simulation, it can inform health-service demand, capacity and disruption scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-simpy-streamlit-healthcare-des provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
